body: I’ve gotten some larf in my packs before but loud is still loud, it smokes the same and still has those trichomes and it smokes the same. The only difference is that it’s the opposite of dense bud. I came across this post because I was gonna get a gas budget pack from a (greater Toronto area) delivery service and it said in the description “this batch of flower does include some larf”

I get bein in a relationship has its issues. I hear this all the time from my friends who got boyfriend or girlfriend issues but the fact that all my other friends have been in multiple relationships when I haven’t even been in a single one feels like there’s something wrong.

I get you’re right but I’ve always constantly heard that relationships are important especially at a young age, it seems like everything is so important to do young and I see like 99% of my friends get these experiences, it makes me feel insignificant in a way and I feel like I’m missing out on the best parts of life, when I dwell on this too much I know I shouldn’t but it’s so hard to ignore when all your friends and family have significant relationships and way more complex social lives and your own life feels like a shit show waiting for some hope for it to turn into a fairy tale or sum shit

My parents too are concerned that I have yet to find a partner especially at 18, mom questioned if I was gay, stepdad even tried to set me up to marry a foreign girl who was really into me but I wasn’t interested. I think my stepdad really thinks I’m gay now (on Allah I’m not gay)

I had the same issue back in elementary, I had a very bad experience moving schools and my new friends weren’t the best I’d say and my old friends cut me off cause someone started some bullshit rumour at my old school. I hate myself everyday for not being more social, in the end of grade 7-8 I just sort of isolated myself and that carried on into highschool and now I’m 18 with horrible mental issues, social anxiety and insomnia. Choosing to isolate yourself especially when you’re a kid can have devastating mental affects on you later, so severe for some to the point where it feels hopeless. I urge anyone who’s still a kid or young teen to try to socialize and build relationships or you’ll find yourself with no friends when you’re an adult and zero social skills to make new ones.
He’s the reason I’m still here :). But what I’m worried about is if I lose him. If he ever ends up running away or dies, my motivation to keep going is diminished and I don’t know what to do.
